_comment: Restricted-use / DUA-required dataset fingerprints. Used by safety-scan.sh to detect a dataset even when its filename has been renamed. A match requires EITHER (a) a filename token, OR (b) ALL columns in any one column_signatures group present in the file's first (header) line — case-insensitive. Two-column signatures are required (single-column hits like a bare SEQN are too easy to collide). Filename tokens are POSIX-ERE fragments (use [0-9] not \d for portability); the scanner wraps each token with non-alphanumeric boundaries to prevent substring collisions like 'anes_' matching inside 'nhanes_'.
